status_summary: On 2025-03-07 HHS OCR announced four investigations of medical schools and hospitals over race, color, national origin or sex preferences in education, training and scholarship programs under Title VI and Section 1557, citing Executive Order 14173. No general statement of policy refocusing Section 1557 enforcement, no joint campaign with the Education Department on pregnant athletes and no announced enforcement on premature infants or children born alive was found. The FY 2027 Medicare inpatient payment final rule, published 2026-08-04 and effective 2026-10-01, requires approved residency programs not to discriminate on race, color, national origin, sex, age, disability or religion, which is a CMS rule rather than OCR enforcement.

timeline.event: HHS OCR announced four investigations of medical schools and hospitals over race-, color-, national origin- or sex-based education, training or scholarship programs, citing Title VI and Section 1557.

CMS published the FY 2027 inpatient payment final rule (91 FR 49570, effective 2026-10-01), which requires approved medical residency programs not to discriminate on race, color, national origin, sex, age, disability or religion.
